close_reason: Completed all nine Phase 2 stories: policy gating, constrained-execution contracts and lifecycle, durable bindings, trusted profile selection, automation integration, enforcement evidence, and the optional LitterBox decision.
description:
# Phase outcome

Constrained execution. Entry: ordered sequence plus policy gate. Exit: profile IDs resolve through trusted host data, portable bindings recover/fork, cells use the lifecycle, and JSONL reports confirmed evidence.

# Ranked child stories

1. `jido_cli-tqg.3.1` — Gate every external effect with authoritative host policy (P0)
2. `jido_cli-tqg.3.2` — Define portable constrained-execution contracts (P0)
3. `jido_cli-tqg.3.3` — Resolve trusted security profiles and fail closed (P0)
4. `jido_cli-tqg.3.4` — Implement the execution-environment lifecycle manager (P0)
5. `jido_cli-tqg.3.5` — Persist portable execution bindings through recovery and fork (P0)
6. `jido_cli-tqg.3.6` — Add data-only execution-profile selection and precedence (P1)
7. `jido_cli-tqg.3.7` — Run each automation cell in one constrained environment (P1)
8. `jido_cli-tqg.3.8` — Publish requested and confirmed enforcement evidence (P1)
9. `jido_cli-tqg.3.9` — Assess and pin or fork the optional LitterBox adapter (P2)

# Status rule

All child stories remain open. Story dependency links, not priority alone, control implementation order.
title: Phase 2: Add constrained execution and security evidence
